To conclude this section, Proposition 42 below summarizes properties regarding the compatibilities of some of the semantics defined in the previous sections. ▶ Proposition 42. Among the different composability and decomposability properties, only the following hold for the mentioned semantics: 1. Ac is only +-compatible and (·, ∗)-decomposable. 2. Tr and SWC are only (a, +)-compatible and (·, ∗)-decomposable. 3. Sh, SM, MM are only a-compatible and (·, +, ∗)-decomposable. 4. BT is only (a, ·, +)-compatible and ∗-decomposable.
